quest.title: Manly Jack's Manly Journey of Manliness
quest.description: Manly Jack needs three Chicken-Mushroom Skewers.

talks.objective: Give Manly Jack three servings of Chicken-Mushroom Skewer

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard you're in need of Chicken-Mushroom Skewers...

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Yeah, I am. You saw my commission, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming over to help me out. So, do you have those three Chicken-Mushroom Skewers?

response.speaker: Manly Jack
response.text: Well, pass them to me as soon as you get them. Eating all that meat's sure to make me a manlier man!

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Wow, smells good. I'll take them.

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: These are for you. Thanks for the help!

dialogues.speaker: Manly Jack
dialogues.text: Now, watch me eat all these in one go...
